a: Varies by participating program; 35-45 awards expected (NSF page); about $18,000,000 total (grants.gov listing).
dt: Submission window Feb 1 - Mar 1, 2027, 5 pm submitter's local time; same window annually.
e: Protected time and support for mid-career researchers to build new skills through a partnership, usually at another institution. The PI must be an associate professor (or equivalent) for at least 3 years, with research in a participating program; for physical scientists this means the BIO programs, such as MCB Molecular Biophysics (MPS and ENG are not listed as participants).
unv: Participating programs taken from NSF's list updated Jan 10, 2025; confirm with an MCA program officer that a physics-based biology project fits.
